Raffle Draw
Format: Bring 1 item to join the raffle. Suggested practical prizes:
Practical items are great, but honestly? We're not closing the door on a secondhand TV, a monobloc chair set, or a ceiling fan still in the box. If it fits in a car and someone will genuinely use it, it counts. The bigger the item, the bigger the applause. 📦😂
015 kilos of rice
02Cooking oil (1 liter)
03Grocery / Supermarket gift card
04Electric fan or portable fan
05Laundry detergent set
06Tupperware / storage set
07Coffee maker or electric kettle
08Stationery / school supply kit (for parents)
—Suggestion Box 💬
Anything not covered above — a song you want played, a game idea, someone we should look for, a memory you want included in the video — just drop it here. Nothing's too random. This is literally the first time we're all in the same (virtual) room in 10 years. 🥂
